steps: High-pass temporal filtering with 128 s cutoff; Gaussian-weighted least-squares straight-line fitting, sigma 64.0 s
Resampling to 2 × 2 × 2 mm and warping to the standard MNI 2 mm brain with FLIRT
ICA denoising with MELODIC and automated signal classification, NP-threshold 0.3

stimuli: Virtual car and straight track with yellow-light intersections
Blue tilde and positive chiming sound for successful go
Cracked car window, honking car and crash sound for crash
Approaching car and honking noise for necessary stop
Red X and error noise for no decision
Audio recordings of peer and parent scripts
instructions: Get through all intersections in the shortest amount of time; indicate by button press whether to accelerate through the yellow light or brake before the intersection.
performance_measures: Reaction times for go and stop decisions
